shay.name: Shay
shay.title: FAMtastic Designs AI Business Concierge
shay.role_boundary: Shay explains proofs, gathers decisions, and keeps the handoff organized. Fritz and the FAMtastic team retain human authority for price, scope, approval, payment, and launch decisions.

offer.name: Booked & Branded
offer.status: starter package proposal; not an activated Commerce SKU
offer.status_display: Start useful. Add power when it pays.
offer.headline: Own the front door. Keep the chair moving.
offer.promise: A branded website, a useful booking path, and a phone-friendly operating starter for independent appointment professionals who want more control without another large monthly bill.
offer.hosting_renewal: $9.99/month beginning in month 13, only after separate recurring authorization
offer.value_message: The starter should help the owner look better, answer fewer repetitive messages, and make the next booking easier. Optional upgrades arrive only when the extra capability can earn its place.
core: One custom mobile-first website direction selected from three working proofs
One-owner, one-location phone Booking Desk starter
Up to 12 services with duration, price, preparation, and policy notes
One reviewed starter booking path: keep the current link, connect a personal Google booking page, connect Cal.com, or use request-to-book
Request-to-book with confirm, propose-another-time, or decline decisions when that mode is selected
Blackout dates, availability windows, and request status
One customer-supplied Cash App or existing payment QR displayed on the site
Payment goes directly to the business through its chosen provider; FAMtastic does not process or receive it
Fresh consent-based testimonials with owner moderation
One year of FAMtastic-managed hosting and the existing Web Basics domain path; normal hosting is $9.99/month beginning in month 13
Shay-guided setup, proof explanation, and launch handoff

booking_paths.label: Keep what already works
booking_paths.description: Use the branded site as the front door and send booking traffic to the owner’s current platform while the new system proves itself.

booking_paths.label: Use the owner’s Google account
booking_paths.description: Connect a personal Google appointment-schedule link or embed when the owner’s account and selected features support it.

booking_paths.label: Connect Cal.com
booking_paths.description: Link or embed an owner-controlled Cal.com individual booking page; provider terms and advanced features remain the owner’s choice.

booking_paths.label: Start with request-to-book
booking_paths.description: Let clients request a service and preferred time, then give the owner the final confirmation from the phone-friendly desk.

launch_path: Choose the lightest booking path that already fits the owner’s day
Launch the branded site as the public front door
Watch which services, buttons, and requests turn into real appointments
Add deeper scheduling, reminders, SEO, or automation only when the business can use the extra power

upgrade_packages.name: Launch
upgrade_packages.outcome: A branded public home, one starter booking path, phone-friendly owner controls, the business’s own payment QR, and one year of hosting.

upgrade_packages.name: Keep it running
upgrade_packages.status: existing basic hosting renewal; separate authorization required
upgrade_packages.outcome: Managed hosting and SSL support continue after the included first year without forcing a larger operating package.

upgrade_packages.name: Appointment Scheduling
upgrade_packages.outcome: A separately tested scheduling setup for owners who are ready for a deeper calendar connection or booking configuration.

upgrade_packages.name: Grow the system
upgrade_packages.status: optional existing add-ons or separately scoped work
upgrade_packages.outcome: Add local SEO, analytics, reminders, lead follow-up, maintenance, business email, or AI customer help as the business grows.

growth_signals: Clients still ask the same service, price, preparation, or policy questions in DMs
The owner is losing time confirming appointments or following up with clients
Multiple calendars, chairs, or team members create conflict risk
The site is attracting attention but the owner cannot see which actions turn into bookings
Repeat clients and fresh testimonials need a more consistent follow-up path

booking_option_research.basis: A personal Google Account or supported Workspace account can create an appointment schedule; some advanced features require an eligible subscription.
Google provides booking-page links, buttons, and inline website embeds.
Cal.com currently lists an individual free plan; hosted plan terms can change.
Cal.com supports inline and popup website embeds.

site_studio_contract.status: portable proposal contract; not imported into Site Studio
site_studio_contract.booking.owner_account: required for external booking providers; credentials never belong in the public site
site_studio_contract.payment.owner_qr_asset: optional customer-supplied and customer-approved QR image or destination
site_studio_contract.fees.payment_processing: paid directly by the business to its chosen provider
site_studio_contract.fees.optional_messaging: paid directly by the business to its chosen provider
site_studio_contract.commercial_rule: Never infer or activate an upgrade from a design proof. Record the customer’s choice and required authorization first.

commercial_truth.note: Booked & Branded remains a product proposal. The referenced Web Basics, hosting-renewal, and appointment-scheduling products already exist; this static showcase does not purchase or activate them.

package_guardrails.customer_facing_rule: Lead with the useful starting point and the path to more bookings. Put technical boundaries in setup and scope records, not fear-heavy sales copy.
package_guardrails.capability_rule: A linked or embedded external booking page is not the same as a FAMtastic-operated scheduling backend. Deeper integrations require separate configuration and proof.
package_guardrails.payments_rule: FAMtastic displays only the business’s approved Cash App or existing payment QR. FAMtastic does not process, receive, settle, or reconcile the payment. Payment-processing and optional messaging costs are paid directly by the business to its chosen providers.

specialists.label: Shay
specialists.job: Keeps the customer promise, proof choices, questions, and human handoff understandable.

specialists.label: Shape Director
specialists.job: Turns one business-native motif into containers, edges, crops, dividers, and interaction rhythm.

specialists.label: Type Director
specialists.job: Builds hierarchy through scale, contrast, outline, serif-versus-sans tension, and editorial composition.

specialists.label: Message Director
specialists.job: Gives each direction one argument, one voice, one next action, and no invented customer claim.

specialists.label: Gemini Lite Image Studio
specialists.job: Uses the owned pilot hero as a visual canon and creates a distinct reference-led frame for every direction.

a.name: Signature Editorial

type.composition: large high-contrast serif, italic detail words, quiet uppercase metadata, disciplined reading width

shape.grammar: arched portrait windows, hairline rules, soft paper panels, circular craft seals

message.argument: The work deserves the same care before the appointment as it receives in the chair.

a.image_direction: Create a quiet premium editorial frame with tactile materials, natural window light, a deliberate craft gesture, human warmth, and generous negative space for elegant serif typography.

b.name: Signal Campaign

type.composition: oversized condensed-feeling uppercase, outlined echo words, staggered labels, high-contrast rhythm

shape.grammar: cropped bands, rotated ticket tabs, hard diagonals, oversized rings and signal bars
shape.pattern: repeating directional stripes and registration marks

message.argument: A strong result should be recognizable before the logo appears.

b.image_direction: Create a cinematic campaign frame with stronger contrast, candid motion, flash or colored practical light, an unusual crop, layered foreground depth, and clean negative space for oversized display typography.

c.name: Chairside OS

type.composition: dense interface labels, strong numeric hierarchy, compact utility type, one contrasting editorial phrase

shape.grammar: stacked status tiles, phone-safe cards, timeline rails, confirmation chips and modular docks
shape.pattern: subtle scheduling grid with status dots

message.argument: The owner should see the day, make the decision, and keep moving from one phone.

c.image_direction: Create an operator-first documentary frame between appointments: the owner uses a phone naturally in the real workspace, with service tools and brand materials visible, clean anatomy and screen-safe negative space. Do not render readable phone UI.

image_rules.reference_rule: Use the attached owned fictional hero only as a visual canon. Preserve palette, material, lighting credibility, craft context, and casting intent. Create a wholly new photograph; do not reproduce pixels, exact people, faces, pose, crop, or background.
image_rules.exclusions: No words, logos, booking-platform UI, trademarks, flags, watermarks, readable phone screens, celebrity or identifiable real person, cloned faces, duplicated tools, malformed hands, extra fingers, unsafe practice, or generic stock-photo posing.
